# Remind patients of an appointment

Send a WhatsApp reminder before an appointment, and skip it when the patient already replied or the visit was cancelled.

A clinic uses Whatsable to remind a patient before a visit, and to answer the people who write back, without texting each number by hand.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Send a reminder only to a person who agreed to hear from the clinic on WhatsApp. Keep diagnosis and treatment details out of the template text. [WhatsApp's Business Messaging Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-policy/) requires that opt-in, and it tells a clinic not to send health information where the law requires a system built for health data.

## Set it up

**Approve a reminder template**

Create a template that names the time and what to bring, and submit it to Meta. See [Message templates](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates).

**Label the visit**

Create a label such as Confirmed or Cancelled. Keywords or a teammate can apply it. See [Labels](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels).

**Schedule the reminder**

Schedule the template for the day before the visit. Add a condition so it sends only if the patient has not replied, and only if the contact does not carry Cancelled. See [Conditional follow-ups](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups).

**Answer the reply**

A patient who writes back is in the [inbox](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-inbox). Inside 24 hours the team can reply in text. After that, send a template.

**Cover closed hours**

Turn on the [away message](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies) so a message at night gets one reply and the label Needs Review.

Scheduled messages with conditions are on Work, Growth, Pro and Agency, on the Free plan, and during the 14-day trial. The Bulk Message plan does not include them. An AI agent that answers patients is on Growth, Pro and Agency.

## FAQ

**Does the reminder send if they already confirmed?**

Not if you set the condition. Whatsable checks it when the message is due. A reply, or a Cancelled label, means nothing is sent.

**Can the team see only their own patients?**

On a plan with team roles, limit a Member to a label or a number. There is no assignee field. See [Route conversations to the right teammate](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/chat-assignment).
